messages._PewterMartYoungsterText: A shady old man got me to buy this really weird fish POKEMON!It's totally weak and it cost P500!
messages._PewterMartSuperNerdText: Good things can happen if you raise POKEMON diligently, even the weak ones!
messages._PewterNidoranHouseMiddleAgedManText: Our POKEMON's an outsider, so it's hard to handle.An outsider is a POKEMON that you get in a trade.It grows fast, but it may ignore an unskilled trainer in battle!If only we had some BADGEs...
messages._PewterSpeechHouseGamblerText: POKEMON learn new techniques as they grow!But, some moves must be taught by the trainer!
messages._PewterSpeechHouseYoungsterText: POKEMON become easier to catch when they are hurt or asleep!But, it's not a sure thing!
messages._PewterPokecenterGentlemanText: What!?TEAM ROCKET is at MT.MOON? Huh? I'm on the phone!Scram!
messages._PewterPokecenterText3: POKEMON CENTERS are wonderful!They heal POKEMON completely.Even conditions like sleep, burn, poison and others are cured.
messages._Museum1FScientist1WouldYouLikeToComeInT: It's P50 for a child's ticket.Would you like to come in?
messages._Museum1FScientist1DoYouKnowWhatAmberIsT: You can't sneak in the back way!Oh, whatever! Do you know what AMBER is?
messages._Museum1FScientist1TheresALabSomewhereTe: There's a lab somewhere trying to resurrect ancient POKEMON from AMBER.
messages._Museum1FScientist1AmberIsFossilizedTree: AMBER is fossil- ized tree sap.
messages._Museum1FScientist1GoToOtherSideText: Please go to the other side!
messages._Museum1FScientist1TakePlentyOfTimeText: Take plenty of time to look!
messages._Museum1FScientist2TakeThisToAPokemonLab: Ssh! I think that this chunk of AMBER contains POKEMON DNA!It would be great if POKEMON could be resurrected from it!But, my colleagues just ignore me!So, I have a favor to ask!Take this to a POKEMON LAB and get it examined!
messages._Museum1FScientist2GetTheOldAmberCheckTe: Ssh! Get the OLD AMBER checked!
messages._Museum1FScientist2YouDontHaveSpaceText: You don't have space for this!
messages._Museum1FScientist3Text: We are proud of 2 fossils of very rare, prehistoric POKEMON!
messages._Museum1FOldAmberText: The AMBER is clear and gold!
messages._Museum2FYoungsterText: MOON STONE?What's so special about it?
messages._Museum2FGrampsText: July 20, 1969!The 1st lunar landing!I bought a color TV to watch it!
messages._Museum2FScientistText: We have a space exhibit now.
messages._Museum2FBrunetteGirlText: I want a PIKACHU! It's so cute!I asked my Daddy to catch me one!
messages._Museum2FHikerText: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!
messages._Museum2FPikachuText1: Your PIKACHU looks untamed. May I have it for my daughter?
messages._Museum2FPikachuText2: I'd like to get that PIKACHU off you, but it's too attached to you.
messages._Museum2FMoonStoneSignText: Meteorite that fell on MT.MOON. (MOON STONE?)
